title: Preserve native DataFrame and Series container types in indexable
answers: Why does cross_val_score or cross_val_predict pass Narwhals DataFrames to estimators?
How to ensure indexable returns native DataFrame types instead of Narwhals objects?
Estimators fail during cross-validation because DataFrame input type was converted by indexable
body:
Symptom: Cross-validation tools pass Narwhals DataFrames or Series to downstream estimators instead of native DataFrame types.
Root cause: sklearn/utils/validation.py:_make_indexable converted native dataframes to Narwhals objects using nw.from_native.
Fix pattern: Return native containers unchanged from indexable helpers so input container type equals output container type.
Constraints: Applies to indexable validation for estimators; does not prevent using Narwhals in internal helpers that convert back before returning.
applies: Input validation and cross-validation indexing of DataFrame and Series objects
